title: On Dominating the valley from the north ridge
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：dominate　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dominate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower ① dominated the valley from the north ridge on the same day, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② dominates the valley from the north ridge before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ dominate the valley from the north ridge at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dominated the valley from the north ridge before — a line in the ledger for August 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dominating the valley from the north ridge on the same day, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ dominate the trade for fifty years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Dominate the trade for fifty years at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ dominates the trade for fifty years on the same day every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dominated the valley from the north ridge again when nobody else would.

⑩ To dominate the valley from the north ridge, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody dominates the valley from the north ridge before dawn again and somebody must dominate the valley from the north ridge on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 俯视（一般过去式 dominated the valley from the north ridge：1989 年种植户头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 俯视（一般现在 dominates the valley from the north ridge：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 俯视（不定式 to dominate the valley from the north ridge：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 俯视（过去完成时 had dominated the valley from the north ridge：1983 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 俯视（动名词 dominating the valley from the north ridge 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 支配（dominate the trade for fifty years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去支配把这门生意把持了五十年）
G. v. 支配（dominate the trade for fifty years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 俯视（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 dominates the trade for fifty years，而母亲又一次 dominated the valley from the north ridge）

answers.why: dominate 意为“俯视”，1989 年种植户当天就俯视自北岭俯瞰整条山谷，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 dominated。
dominate 意为“俯视”，自那以后种植户天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 dominates。
dominate 意为“俯视”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯俯视自北岭俯瞰整条山谷”，此处为不定式 to dominate the valley from the north ridge。
dominate 意为“俯视”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人俯视过，故用过去完成时 had dominated。
dominate 意为“俯视”，种植户说“俯视自北岭俯瞰整条山谷这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 dominating the valley from the north ridge 作主语。
dominate 意为“支配”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去支配把这门生意把持了五十年”，should ever 之后用原形 dominate the trade for fifty years。
dominate 意为“支配”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻支配把这门生意把持了五十年（dominate the trade for fifty years at once），以后再也不要提起。
dominate 意为“俯视”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例支配把这门生意把持了五十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 dominates。
dominate 意为“俯视”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就俯视自北岭俯瞰整条山谷，用一般过去式 dominated 叙述。
dominate 意为“俯视”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要俯视自北岭俯瞰整条山谷，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dominate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the grower dominated the valley from the north ridge on the same day, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower dominates the valley from the north ridge before dawn whenever the greenhouse asks.
Dominating the valley from the north ridge on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever dominate the trade for fifty years before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse dominates the trade for fifty years on the same day every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother dominated the valley from the north ridge again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
